profile.headline: Software Engineer at Honeywell
profile.summary:
Hello, I am Anderson, an enthusiastic software engineer with a passion for constant learning and finding the most strategic and logical solutions to every problem that I am faced with.

During my time at General Motors as a software engineer, I have developed innovative solutions and effectively collaborated with other cross-functional teams. Here at General Motors, I have learned to thrive in fast-paced environments, enjoy new challenges and have come to love both the customer-facing and back-end of systems.

positions.title: Advanced Software Engineer
positions.insights: Python (Programming Language), C (Programming Language) and +1 skill

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: During my time at Honeywell I have been developing Windows software that is used to interface with and test Honeywell Anthem Displays. This involves writing, debugging and releasing C code that interfaces to hardware via ethernet as well as JTAG interfaces. Through this experience I have become well-versed in writing Windows software as well as fundamentally understanding and using the User Datagram Protocol (UDP) in networking. During my time here I achieved a 75% increase in software stability by reducing potential fatal exceptions, all while decreasing overhead and CPU usage by 50%.

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description: During my time at General Motors, I have made significant contributions across various software development projects. I was promoted almost two years ahead of schedule out of the New College Hire program due to exceeding goals and expectations. Notably, I led the implementation of a scheduling system that integrated with Microsoft Teams and Salesforce, enabling customers to book appointments with sales agents. Additionally, I played a lead role in the implementation of Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Salesforce CRM, as well as creating integrations between these systems and external platforms by creating various REST APIs. I developed a website using TypeScript and React to collect referral data from dealership agents and created APIs using Java and Apex to facilitate communication between various systems, including a mobile app and external website. Furthermore, I was responsible for coding all the emails that were being sent by GM Energy according to the designs provided by our creative team.

positions.title: Retail Sales Manager
positions.description: I worked as a team leader and key holder in charge of opening the store on weekends and closing on weekdays. During my time here, I learned how to manage my resources and work collaboratively with others as I was not only in charge of other staff members but of the store itself.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description: As a Web Developer Intern at Thinq.TV from February 2020 to August 2021, I utilized Ruby on Rails to develop and maintain a website that enabled users to create video chat rooms based on specific topics and schedule them on a calendar for others to join. I was responsible for developing a solution to handle time and date reminders tailored to each user's time zone, ensuring a seamless experience across different locations. Additionally, I collaborated with other teams, coordinating tasks and ensuring everyone remained on track throughout the development process. My internship at Thinq.TV allowed me to gain hands-on experience with web development using Ruby on Rails, while also honing your skills in project coordination and teamwork.
positions.insights: REST APIs, Ruby on Rails and +3 skills
